ModMetaData.name: 8‑Bit Performance Mode
ModMetaData.author: YewChicken
ModMetaData.description: Turns RimWorld into a retro, ultra‑low‑graphics mode designed for players on low‑end or budget devices. This mod procedurally downscales world textures, reduces color depth, and simplifies visuals to dramatically improve performance while giving the game a chunky 8‑bit aesthetic. UI textures remain untouched for clarity.
